We recently completed the Tawang–Kaziranga tour with Uphoria Travels
, and overall it was a wonderful and memorable experience for our family. The itinerary was very well planned, covering beautiful destinations like Guwahati, Kaziranga, Sangti Valley, Tawang, Bumla Pass, Madhuri Lake, and Bomdila without feeling too rushed. The entire trip was organized smoothly from pickup to drop.

A special mention to the driver and support team for being punctual, polite, and cooperative throughout the journey. Traveling in the North-East can be challenging because of long mountain routes and weather conditions, but everything was handled professionally and comfortably.

All the hotels arranged during the trip were very good in terms of cleanliness, hospitality, food, and location. Especially the stays in Tawang and Sangti Valley were excellent and added great value to the experience. The only hotel that felt comparatively moderate was the stay at Namsai/Bomdila, but it was still manageable for a short stay. Apart from that, the remaining accommodations exceeded expectations.

The sightseeing experiences were amazing — Kaziranga safari, Sela Pass, Madhuri Lake, Bumla Pass, and the scenic landscapes throughout the journey were truly unforgettable. The itinerary balanced nature, adventure, spirituality, and relaxation very well.

Overall, we are very satisfied with the service provided by Uphoria Travels and would definitely recommend them to anyone planning a North-East trip. Thank you for making our vacation memorable!
